description: Figure 7 (bottom plot) illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset as a function of subject entity popularity (s_pop frequency, scaled by ×10⁴). The x-axis ranges from 1 to 19 in increments of 2, representing binned popularity levels. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” spans from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. Two lines are plotted: “Initial Accuracy” (green line with square markers and error bars) and “Final Accuracy” (blue dashed line with triangle markers and error bars). Initial Accuracy starts at approximately 0.38 at s_pop = 1, fluctuates between 0.4 and 0.7 across intermediate bins, and rises sharply to 1.0 at s_pop = 19. Final Accuracy begins at 0.7 at s_pop = 1, increases to a peak of 1.0 at s_pop = 5, dips slightly to 0.95 at s_pop = 13, then rises again to 1.0 at s_pop = 17 and remains there. Error bars are visible on both lines, indicating variability in measurements across bins.
